question: we have about a thousand teacher packets; why has every arm only ever drawn from 139 in-domain cut geometries?
answer: 920 packets exist, 273 are in V2_LABELS.json, and 100 in-domain CUT packets have never been used by anything

the_100_unused_in_domain_cut.source_scientific_status: COMPLETE_LOCAL_OPERATOR_PRODUCTION_CHECKS_PASS - the same string the 273 in use carry

why_were_they_excluded.not_the_authorisation_flag: neural_training_authorized is False on ALL 920, in and out of the manifest, so it is a teacher-side formality and not the filter
why_were_they_excluded.not_quality: their status string is identical to the packets in use
why_were_they_excluded.most_likely: they were never ingested: the manifest was built from what had been processed by 2026-09-17, and their q is markedly larger (median 27270 against 15522), which makes the label build more expensive. This is inference, not established.
why_were_they_excluded.what_would_settle_it: the ingest pipeline's own log or selection rule, which is not on this box

the_value.training_pool: 139 -> 239 in-domain cut geometries, +72 %. Measured flatness in n (8 = 28 = 59 give the same held-out median) says this ALONE is unlikely to move the 14x gap.
the_value.a_real_reserved_held_out_set: 44 of the 100 are dataset-designated test (22) and validation (22) and have been presented to NOTHING. Today's standing problem is that only 2 of 184 cut seats were never presented anywhere, both out of domain, so every 'held-out' set in this project is held out BY OMISSION. These 44 are not.
the_value.scale: q up to 47760 across the unused set, against 25932 in the manifest

the_reference_stage_is_basis_dependent_a.rebuilt_seat_220_R_UPPER: sha 953d8cd0... against the recorded d1b645a0...; matrix_frobenius identical to every printed digit (2.0859046806597115), minimum_diagonal identical to 14 digits, operator relative difference 0.374 - the signature of the same operator in a different basis of the rigid complement
the_reference_stage_is_basis_dependent_a.so_what: B is not unique, and our Householder quotient is not theirs

but_the_LABEL_is_basis_free_and_this_was.identity: A' = U A U^T with B' = U B gives B'^T A'^(-1/2) B' = B^T A^(-1/2) B, so M_q = ((Pi S Pi)^+)^(1/2) with Pi = B^T B depends on S and the node set alone
but_the_LABEL_is_basis_free_and_this_was.verdict: SAME_LABEL_SPACE - labels we build ourselves can be mixed with the existing 139

can_we_build_the_labels.route: packet S_UPPER -> our own quotient -> A -> eigh -> M_q, skipping the reference stage entirely: 11.3 s at q = 13248
can_we_build_the_labels.still_needed_per_packet: a TRACE_CACHE, which the trace stage produces in about 25 s and which we reproduced byte for byte tonight in the rotation witness BASE_REPLAY
can_we_build_the_labels.estimated_total_for_100: about 2-3 h of GPU, roughly 200 GB if only MQ_UPPER and the cache are kept, roughly 340 GB if a self-consistent R_UPPER is kept too (evaluation reads it as the whitener)
